text:
Priya (Partnerships): quick sync - starting onboarding for a new partner listing (AWS + GCP + Azure). main asks: image/AMI ingest, trial config, pricing SKU matrix, and legal addendum. timeline: pilot in staging next Tue. who can take lead on each?
Andre (CloudOps): I can own image/AMI ingestion and signing. remind partner to provide checksum and signer principal. for GCP we need a `gcp-image-name` and for Azure a managed image id. also ask for cloud-init user-data snippet.
Tom (Product): i'll design SKU matrix. suggestion: Starter (30d trial) sku=redwood-start-30, Team sku=redwood-team, pricing starter=$0.12/1k tokens, team=$0.10/1k with seat-based metering. we should support BYOC licensing note too.
Rina (Legal): flag: marketplace listings need the Marketplace Addendum + Data Processing Annex. partner can sign our standard addendum or provide their own, but our counsel needs to review any changes. attach drafts early.
Priya (Partnerships): good. MarketplaceBot, can we pre-provision a sandbox publisher account and entitlement mapping for smoke runs?
MarketplaceBot: Created sandbox publisher `rwd-pub-sbx-204`. Please submit entitlement CSV: columns = display_name, sku, trial_days, meter_unit.
Andre (CloudOps): ops note: AMIs must be in our account or shared via snapshot with `rwd-marketplace-ingest` role. request role ARN `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rwd-marketplace-ingest`. also KMS key policy must allow `Encrypt/Decrypt` for that role.
Tom (Product): marketing assets: short blurb <=280 chars, 3 bullet points, 1200x800 hero, 16:9 gif. put into /shared/marketplace/assets/<vendor>. also need short demo runbook for smoke test steps.
Rina (Legal): also confirm export control classification with partner if ARG-based models included. addendum template: `marketplace-addendum-v3.pdf`.
Priya (Partnerships): SI partners ask: some integrators want a co-marketing blurb and joint announcement window. propose announcing after 2 weeks of pilot. any objections?
Tom (Product): sounds fine. coordinate with comms. we should also gate announcements on security scan + smoke test pass.
Andre (CloudOps): security scan: we'll run a quick container scan (Clair) and image vulnerability report. partners must fix any CVE >=9.0 or provide mitigations.
Priya (Partnerships): action owners: Andre -> artifacts & security; Tom -> SKU + assets + announcement timing; Rina -> legal addendum review; marketplace -> sandbox entitlement. ETA: initial artifacts + drafts by Fri 3pm PT.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: upload manifest JSON with fields: `sku`, `image_uri`, `sha256`, `regions`, `min_gpu`, `trial_days`, `meter_unit`.
Priya (Partnerships): sample manifest snippet we expect (paste in docs channel). please follow naming convention: `<vendor>-<product>-<semver>.json.
Tom (Product): quick pricing question: do we allow custom promo codes for marketplace trials or route promos via partner coupon?
Rina (Legal): coupons are fine but require tracking terms. include promo T&Cs in the addendum if they're partner-managed.
Andre (CloudOps): one more: for Azure marketplace the VM offer requires a `Offer ID` and the publisher must accept the offer terms in Partner Center. partner to confirm they've completed Partner Center onboarding.
Priya (Partnerships): noted. i'll send a partner checklist doc and assign owners there. ping me if you need access to the sandbox publisher account.
Tom (Product): adding performance targets: target p95 < 450ms for small inference on starter SKU; please capture perf profile in manifest as `seq_len_profile` with buckets.
MarketplaceBot: Entitlement mapping template attached in #docs.
Rina (Legal): pls upload signed addendum as `partner-marketplace-addendum-<vendor>.pdf` into shared legal folder. counsel will triage within 24-48 hrs.
Andre (CloudOps): ack, working on ingestion playbook. will post CLI examples using `rwd-market publish --cloud aws --image s3://... --sku redwood-start-30 --sha256 <hash>`.
Priya (Partnerships): thanks team. i'll close this thread once staging smoke tests pass. drop short updates here only. :raised_hands:
